name: perception-ark
description: 感知方舟 · 视障人群AI感知眼镜 · TRAE五智能体协作

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c #00FFA3,#7B61FF "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c #00FFA3,#7B61FF "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build:full: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.preview:prod: npm run build && npm --prefix backend start
